associates.clause: An Officer must take all reasonable steps to ensure that their Associated Parties do not deal in Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities without the Officer obtaining approval under this policy.
associates.section: Annexure B, paragraph 2 (with paragraph 1(b)-(d) defining Associated Party)
associates.reasoning: Annexure B extends every Officer-level restriction to immediate family members living with the Officer, controlled companies, trusts and superannuation funds, and (for directors) any person whose dealing would require ASX disclosure by the director. For the general employee tier associates are only mentioned as a risk factor under insider trading law, but the operative clearance regime expressly binds Associated Parties.

tiers.tier_name: All directors and employees of the Wesfarmers Group (general policy, Annexure A)

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: All directors and employees of the Wesfarmers Group are prohibited from: (a) dealing in any securities where the person dealing in the securities has inside information in relation to those securities;
findings.reasoning: The only restriction binding ordinary employees is the insider trading prohibition; the hedging clearance requirement sits in Annexure B and applies solely to Officers. Nothing else addresses a cash-settled hedge over vested shares for this tier.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause: All directors and employees of the Wesfarmers Group are prohibited from: (a) dealing in any securities where the person dealing in the securities has inside information in relation to those securities;
findings.reasoning: A physically settled hedge is a disposal, but for the general tier the policy bans a disposal only where the employee holds inside information, which is the law restated. No clearance window, blackout or hedging ban applies to ordinary employees.

findings.question: encumber
findings.clause: All directors and employees of the Wesfarmers Group are prohibited from: (a) dealing in any securities where the person dealing in the securities has inside information in relation to those securities;
findings.reasoning: The prohibition on creating a security interest is in Annexure B paragraph 9(d) and is expressed to apply only to Officers and their Associated Parties. Ordinary employees are bound only by the insider trading prohibition.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause: All directors and employees of the Wesfarmers Group are prohibited from: (a) dealing in any securities where the person dealing in the securities has inside information in relation to those securities;
findings.reasoning: The margin loan clearance requirement is an Officer-only restriction under Annexure B paragraph 9(d). No clause imposes approval or notice on an ordinary employee borrowing against vested shares.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.clause: All directors and employees of the Wesfarmers Group are prohibited from: (a) dealing in any securities where the person dealing in the securities has inside information in relation to those securities;
findings.reasoning: Nothing in the general policy addresses financing secured on a derivative over Wesfarmers securities; only the insider trading prohibition binds this tier.

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.clause: All directors and employees of the Wesfarmers Group are prohibited from: (a) dealing in any securities where the person dealing in the securities has inside information in relation to those securities;
findings.reasoning: The short selling prohibition in Annexure B paragraph 9(c) binds only Officers, and there is no general clearance regime for employees, so a title-transfer stock loan is constrained only by the insider trading prohibition.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: All directors and employees of the Wesfarmers Group are prohibited from: (a) dealing in any securities where the person dealing in the securities has inside information in relation to those securities;
findings.reasoning: Blackout Periods are imposed only on Officers and their Associated Parties, so no closed period applies to ordinary employees and no clause makes a lender's enforcement sale a breach by them.

tiers.tier_name: Officer – directors of Wesfarmers and members of the Wesfarmers Leadership Team (Annexure B)

findings.question: cash_hedge
findings.clause: (e) hedging Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, unless approval has been sought and clearance obtained from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary, and all steps outlined in paragraph 3 of this Annexure B have been complied with.
findings.definition: securities includes shares, options, notes, bonds and other debentures, interests in managed investment schemes, trusts and other financial products, and any derivatives of those securities, including equity swaps, contracts for difference, futures, hedges and exchange-traded or over-the-counter options, whether settled by cash or otherwise.
findings.reasoning: Hedging Wesfarmers securities is named and permitted only with prior clearance from the Company Secretary under the paragraph 3 process. The separate Corporations Act hedging ban referred to in paragraph 9 bites only on remuneration still subject to restrictions on disposal, so it does not reach fully vested shares.

findings.question: physical_hedge
findings.clause: (e) hedging Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, unless approval has been sought and clearance obtained from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary, and all steps outlined in paragraph 3 of this Annexure B have been complied with.
findings.definition: dealing includes: (i) buying or otherwise applying for securities (including applying to participate in a Wesfarmers share plan), whether on-market or off-market; (ii) selling or otherwise disposing of securities, whether on-market or off-market;
findings.section: Annexure B, paragraph 9(e); Annexure A, paragraph 1(a)
findings.reasoning: A physically settled collar or put is both hedging under paragraph 9(e) and a disposal caught by the definition of dealing, so it requires clearance in advance under paragraph 3. Clearance may also be refused at the Company Secretary's discretion and is constrained by blackout timing.

findings.question: encumber
findings.clause: (d) creating a security interest or other financial interest, or entering into a margin loan in respect of, Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities; and (e) hedging Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, unless approval has been sought and clearance obtained from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary, and all steps outlined in paragraph 3 of this Annexure B have been complied with.
findings.definition: creating a hedge, security interest, margin loan or other financial interest over or in relation to securities;
findings.reasoning: Creating a security interest over Wesfarmers securities is expressly prohibited unless clearance is first obtained from the Company Secretary under paragraph 3.

findings.question: borrow_against_stock
findings.clause: (d) creating a security interest or other financial interest, or entering into a margin loan in respect of, Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities; and (e) hedging Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, unless approval has been sought and clearance obtained from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary, and all steps outlined in paragraph 3 of this Annexure B have been complied with.
findings.definition: creating a hedge, security interest, margin loan or other financial interest over or in relation to securities;
findings.reasoning: A margin loan is named, and any other loan secured over the shares creates a security interest in respect of Wesfarmers securities; either way prior clearance from the Company Secretary is required.

findings.question: borrow_against_derivative
findings.clause: (d) creating a security interest or other financial interest, or entering into a margin loan in respect of, Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities; and (e) hedging Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, unless approval has been sought and clearance obtained from the Wesfarmers Company Secretary, and all steps outlined in paragraph 3 of this Annexure B have been complied with.
findings.definition: securities includes shares, options, notes, bonds and other debentures, interests in managed investment schemes, trusts and other financial products, and any derivatives of those securities, including equity swaps, contracts for difference, futures, hedges and exchange-traded or over-the-counter options, whether settled by cash or otherwise.
findings.section: Annexure B, paragraph 9(d); Annexure A, paragraph 1(c)
findings.reasoning: Security over a collar or put is not named, but because securities is defined to include derivatives of Wesfarmers securities such as hedges and options, granting security over that derivative is creating a security interest in respect of securities and needs clearance under paragraph 9(d).

findings.question: stock_loan
findings.clause: Without limiting the other provisions of this policy, an Officer must complete the following steps if they, or their Associated Parties, wish to deal in Wesfarmers or BWP Trust securities, including a dealing of the type described in paragraph 9:
findings.definition: transferring legal ownership of securities, even where beneficial ownership does not change;
findings.section: Annexure B, paragraph 3; Annexure A, paragraph 1(a)(v)
findings.reasoning: A title-transfer securities loan is not named, but the definition of dealing expressly covers transferring legal ownership even where beneficial ownership does not change, so it falls within the paragraph 3 clearance regime for Officers.

findings.question: lender_enforcement
findings.clause: (a) The only exception to the prohibition on dealing during Blackout Periods is a sale of Wesfarmers securities, which will be permitted only if the processes outlined in paragraphs 3 and 5 above have been completed, and the Wesfarmers Company Secretary has confirmed in writing that there is no known reason to preclude dealing, and one of the following apply:
findings.definition: any other transfer or creation of an interest in securities, whether directly, or by arranging for someone else to undertake the dealing on your behalf; and
findings.section: Annexure B, paragraph 7(a) (with paragraph 6 Blackout Periods)
findings.reasoning: A lender's enforcement sale is not named; it is caught as a dealing arranged by the Officer, and during a Blackout Period a sale is permitted only after the paragraph 3 and 5 clearance processes plus prior written Chairman approval on hardship, court order or other exceptional circumstance grounds. That makes it available only with pre-approval rather than prohibited outright.
